2026‐06‐04: OceanFirst Bank Center, West Long Branch, NJ, USA (2026-06-04) (Music America: The Songs That Shaped Us)

~ Concert

  • Overview
  • Event art (2)
  • Aliases

  • Edit

Annotation

Night one of ‘Music America: The Songs That Shaped Us’, a two‐night, multi‐act celebration of America’s 250th anniversary presented by the Bruce Springsteen Center for American Music. Springsteen concludes the night by performing duets with Rosanne Cash, Kenny Chesney, and Dropkick Murphys; all the evening’s artists join Trombone Shorty & New Breed Brass Band for the closing When the Saints Go Marching In. Other performers are Shemekia Copeland, Valerie June, Keb’ Mo’, Tony Trischka and Sister Sadie, and Brian Fallon. The Disciples of Soul serve as the house band, Robert Santelli emcees (providing a running history of American music), and Indigenous Enterprise and a Native American drum circle open the show.
